Sales to continent’s militaries have shifted qualitatively to air-defence systems, armed drones and electronic warfare gear, analysts note
3 -MIN READ 3 -MIN Listen Jevans Nyabiage Published: 6:00pm, 1 Nov 2026 For decades, China has supplied African militaries with small arms and land-based equipment such as armoured vehicles, trucks and artillery.
Analysts noted that China’s African arms sales were shifting qualitatively to air-defence systems, armed drones and electronic warfare gear once dominated by Russia and the West.
